copy.curiosityHook: Peter needs a best man fast, but can a series of painfully clumsy blind dates actually produce a genuine best friend before the wedding day?
copy.description: After proposing to his dream woman Zooey, real estate agent Peter Klaven realizes he lacks any close male companions to be his best man, kicking off an immediate hunt through a string of awkward, mismatched man-dates.
copy.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and breezy, pairing steady comic momentum with low-stress viewing that is ideal to watch with friends.
copy.whyWatch: Director John Hamburg delivers an easygoing, laugh-out-loud comedy that turns modern male bonding and wedding anxiety into a genuinely funny, warm social obstacle course.

allowedMaterial: Peter Klaven's profession as a real estate agent
Realization of having no close male friend to be best man
excludedMaterial: Identity of the eventual best man
Later relationship complications between Peter and Zooey
